name: stri_endswith_charclass
title: Determine if the Start or End of a String Matches a Pattern

origin.description: Report whether the code point at to belongs to a character class.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to test.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: 1-based code-point index. -1 is the last code point. Negative values count back from the end.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If TRUE, report the opposite answer.

origin.details: Only the single code point at to is tested. A to that lands at or before the start follows negate. The trailing NUL is not read. A missing string, pattern, or to is NA. An empty string with to = -1 follows negate.
origin.example:
x <- stri_endswith_charclass("ab1", "\\p{N}")
sentence <- paste0('stri_endswith_charclass("ab1", "\\p{N}") returns ', ifelse(x, "TRUE", "FALSE"), '.')
writeLines(sentence)

translation.description: Report whether the code point at to belongs to a character class.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error. Membership is ICU 76, Unicode 16.

arguments.name: to
arguments.text: 1-based code-point index. -1 is the last code point. Negative values count back from the end.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If true, report the opposite answer.

translation.details: Only the single code point at to is tested. A to that lands at or before the start follows negate. The trailing NUL is not read. A missing string, pattern, or to is NA. An empty string with to = -1 follows negate.
translation.value: A list of bools. A missing result is NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.charclass import stri_endswith_charclass
x = stri_endswith_charclass("ab1", "\\p{N}")
sentence = f'stri_endswith_charclass("ab1", "\\p{{N}}") returns {"TRUE" if x[0] else "FALSE"}.'
print(sentence)
